name: iter_baseline
description: The reference trajectory: the companion paper's operating point (n_bumps 5, noise 0.05, radius 0.25, iters_initial 12, n_train 100, sel_sigma 0.5, mix_ratio 0.5, n_select 100, iters_retrain 400, warm-start) run as a LOOP instead of a single round, over 8 iterations, all three regimes and 10 seeds. Answers the first question the single-round study could not: does the guided advantage survive repetition, and does accumulating the training set remove the catastrophic-forgetting collapse the paper measured under its new-points-only protocol? n_iterations is swept so the trajectory length itself is an axis. Detector trio = the strongest and most diverse at this anchor.
